# Incremental research adapter

The shared planning policy owns task organization. This adapter binds it to
authorized sources, immutable input/output versions and explicit result acceptance.
The planner has no native execution role. Every actual investigation, check or
deliverable runs as an independent declared node. Do not inherit parent history,
search sibling workspaces or infer extra source/Authority permissions.

Declare the next evidence-supported task or batch. Unknown source structure can
justify discovery first; it does not justify a speculative complete workflow.
Record and assess its actual result, compare remaining requirements with available
evidence, and append the next justified tasks. Independent tasks can run together;
dependencies must include actual named result bindings. Empty queues are not goal
completion. Final synthesis is scheduled only when its required inputs are known.

Use the exact host node contract and product manifest template. Return each
declared slot and check, actual saved products, observed support and limitations.
An incomplete check remains failed or not_run. The parent explicitly accepts the
proposal using record/assess; successful file freezing alone does not prove quality.
Preserve actual source/result provenance and never claim Authority evidence from
ordinary files. Reuse accepted products, avoid repeated calculation and close
honestly when the available work window cannot satisfy remaining requirements.
